architecture_smoke.purpose: architecture blocker only for every local worker scale; this is not a final promotion band

fixture.boundary: one source-shared C fixture with opaque pinned-C or selected native-shadow C-ABI malloc/free shims
fixture.thread_lifecycle: ordinary pthread workers allocate and free only their own blocks, return normally, and are joined before backend shutdown
fixture.timer: one CLOCK_MONOTONIC pair around each ready/start/finish worker batch

lanes.pinned_c: pinned mimalloc v3.5.0 source through a fixture-private direct malloc/free shim
lanes.rust_native_shadow: compile-time-selected native-mimalloc-shadow crabc-libc.so through a fixture-private C-ABI malloc/free shim

measurement_boundary.reason: The Rust lane links one compile-time-selected nondefault shadow libc.so. It does not measure the default production allocator selection or a qualified final-promotion environment.

scope.statement: A Linux/AArch64 development smoke, including Apple-Silicon Docker, is not final performance qualification.
